Vanessa —

Quick handoff for StitchPoint (DEAL-8921). High-level summary and asks below. Please see attached SOW draft and deployment checklist; procurement and legal are already engaged (cc'd on later thread).

Deal highlights:
- Contract value: $420k ARR, 12-month term starting on assigned go-live date.
- Primary use: inference for analytics + contextual search across internal docs.
- Expected QPS: bursty during business hours; target 95th pct latency SLA on dedicated pool.

Key dates / expectations:
- Proposed Sprint 0 / kickoff: Week of 2026-07-06.
- Target pilot (prod-like): 8 weeks after kickoff.
- Billing to start when tenant is production-tagged (we're proposing to align with go-live).

Known risks / notes:
- Customer requires private VPC peering and strict data retention settings (they mentioned SOC 2 controls).
- Procurement has a few redlines around indemnity and SLAs — legal will share final by EOD 7/2.

Attachments included: StitchPoint_SOW_v1.pdf, stitchpoint-deployment-checklist.xlsx (network + credentials section).

Asks for CS:
1) Confirm primary CS and ops owners for the kickoff and Sprint 0.
2) Confirm a 60–90 minute kickoff slot the week of 7/6 (customer prefers mornings PT).
3) Flag any immediate blocking technical dependencies (VPN/IP ranges, service account with access to staging).

I'll leave the scheduling in your hands. Ben is our deal lead for procurement questions; Dev is the SE point for technical fit.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: StitchPoint launch: Sales→CS kickoff and Sprint 0 roster

Adding technical context so CS has clear pre-kickoff requirements.

Short technical summary:
- Target infra: customer will request a private Dedicated pool (NVIDIA A100) in their VPC via VPC peering. We'll provide a CE-approved template for peering and a service account.
- Network: need customer CIDR blocks and at least two static IPs for egress-to-redwood endpoints. We'll require ports 443 outbound and a pinned set of IPs for peering.
- Auth: prefer OIDC-backed service account; fallback is API key scoped to test tenant.
- Data: they asked for 90-day retention by default; confirm retention window and encryption-at-rest key (if they require KMS/HSM).
- Staging: recommend temporary staging tenant (isolated) to mirror prod for latency testing.

Pre-kickoff technical checklist (I'll action):
- Provide network requirements PDF and peering template (attached).
- Share seeding script and minimal sample dataset format (CSV/JSON examples).
- Provide timeline estimate for tenant provisioning (typically 48–72 hours after peering and credentials).

I've attached 'network-requirements.pdf' and will follow up with the staging tenant provisioning steps after legal finalizes SOW.

— Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com
